notes.title: Remix Mode lands on September 29 🚀
notes.content:
Everyone at Kindred HQ has been listening & we kept hearing three letters being repeated over & over & over (& over) again…

[h3]D L C[/h3]

Apparently “free DLC” has been the talk of the intergalactic town & we thought what better way to appease those townsfolk than giving them exactly that?!

We’re pleased to announce that Remix Mode, a new free DLC, will be coming to Revenge of the Savage Planet in four days!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/2a19fe1c896d5b4301acf00da54d8b76aba35e02.png[/img]

[h2]What are we remixing? 🤔[/h2]

We’re remixing EVERYTHING.

Okay, maybe not literally everything, but there is definitely a lot to sink your teeth into including three brand-new preset modes that allow you to play in any way your little heart desires.

& while we’re not allowed to spoil all the details at this stage, here’s an initial look at what you can expect…

🟠 [b]Immersive Mode[/b] - No hints or help. Play the way grandpa intended.

🟠 [b]Old Game Minus[/b] - It’s back! Another way of saying hard mode. Maybe even super hard mode. Lose your lives & we delete your save.

🟠 [b]Sandbox[/b] - Not a literal box of sand because that would be boring. Instead, let out your inner child & adjust up to 30 settings for a unique Savage Planet experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/efd2f89c623623ad236ea3278759d93df985c362.png[/img]

[h2]But wait… there’s more 🦖[/h2]

We couldn’t let you switch up the experience without changing your attire.

Included in this free DLC are new character customization options including a fresh character skin & new color variations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/193169d78ee64e6f3c30d60e64846220e6f705c2.png[/img]

This lil' Kaiju guy is the latest addition to an extensive catalog of completely random yet totally appropriate outer space fits. It just works!

Oh & one more thing. If you're interested in our soundtrack, the full score will debut on your favorite Earth-based streaming platforms like Spotify & Apple Music on Monday too.

Stay tuned to our channels for more information over the next few days, ready for our launch on September 29th! 🧡

Well, guess what? [b]IT’S HERE FOR YOUR FACES![/b]

We’re coming at you straight from Kindred HQ with a returning Photo Mode, Performance Mode for console users, additional habitat decor & some essential bug fixes to make your space adventures 97.3% smoother (p.s. don’t question the maths).

[i]“But what exactly can I expect?!”[/i] we hear you scream from Stellaris Prime. We got you covered…
[/p][h2]Say Cheeeeese 📸[/h2][p]

🔸 12 filters

🔸 47 character poses

The most impressive photo wins, erm… something? Stay tuned for more on that actually.

notes.title: Our Day 60 patch is HERE! 🚨
notes.content:
Not sure if we technically ever left, but either way, we’re SO back with another update for your interplanetary exploration!

We’ve got a bunch of fixes & tweaks across the board, including:

[b]🔶 More solid save games
🔶 Kindex entry improvements
🔶 Resolved upgrade glitches
🔶 Creature capture refinements
🔶 & much more![/b]

But before we fully dive into the juicy bits, we wanted to take this time to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to anyone who has bought & played our game so far.

As a team of 30 people, we’re eternally grateful for every single one of you & we’re excited to share more from our roadmap after this latest update.

[i]P.S. Any reviews are super appreciated by both us & Martin Tweed! 🧡[/i]

Now, for the bit you’ve all been waiting for…

[h2]Full Patch Notes 👇[/h2]

[u]Gameplay[/u] 

[list]
[*] Fixed issues with Resource Backup Storage locations, and ensured players that had experienced issues with coop partners disconnecting don’t lose the resources the partner had collected
[*] Fixed a bug causing an important character to be invisible after the final bossfight
[*] Improvements to stagger and creature capture, making it easier to aim at and hit the stagger points with aim assist
[*] Fixed various bugs relating to creature behavior
[*] Fixed a few issues with upgrades (availability and notifications)
[/list]

[u]World / Quests[/u]

[list]
[*] Added various new tutorials to help players, particularly if they’re dying during tough fights where acquiring more upgrades would really help
[*] Stopped the Shama Lama podium (Cosmic Hoarder Edition) resetting after completion so you can go back and enjoy them again
[*] Made sure the Kindex is completable at 100%
[*] Fixed various places where players could potentially get trapped or escape the world
[*] Fixed and added missing VOs
[/list]

[u]UI[/u]

[list]
[*] Making sure the displayed % for planet completion are correct
[*] Teleporter map navigation improvements
[*] Added missing out of bound notifications
[*] Few UI improvements on notifications 
[*] Tweaks to map and icons for better visibility
[*] Upgrade descriptions can now be scrolled using controller
[*] Fixed loading screen issues
[/list]

[u]Others[/u]

[list]
[*] Inverted Look Axis now works in building mode
[*] Various performance optimizations 
[*] Fixed several replication issues
[*] Improved rumble behaviour across many aspects of the game.
[*] Fix bug where some Interactions caused teleporting issues
[*] Fixed remaining issues with corrupted save games
[*] Improve Xbox Invite flow
[*] Make sure credits can be skipped in Splitscreen
[*] Fixed controller and keyboard connection/recognition issues
[*] Improved alt-tabbing in/out of the game causing weird focus issues where the game would only be partially responsive
[/list]

notes.title: Price Drop! Gifts for Early Adopters! Big Patch! Roadmap!
notes.content: [p]Dear Valuable Employees,[/p][p] [/p][p]It’s been more than a month since we launched the mission to Nu Florida, and what a month it’s been! In case you missed it, we have a bunch of news for you so do not delete this corporate email yet![/p][p][/p][h2]The Day 30 patch[/h2][p][/p][p]It’s our biggest update yet, addressing a lot of issues you’ve encountered, bringing performance improvements, along with implementing some of your best suggestions. So if you haven’t already, update your game, and let us know if you have any more issues! In case you didn’t know where to report a bug or if you have any suggestions or questions, head to our Discord! [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787320/Revenge_of_the_Savage_Planet/"] Read the full patchnotes here.[/url][/p][p][/p][h2]Permanent price decrease[/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve heard you. Revenge of the Savage Planet price has been permanently decreased. By making the game more accessible, we want to make sure you’ll always find a space buddy with you - and if you don’t have anyone to play with… Head to the Discord![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/7ae37f182160b754969a6ac928a72f902c01bcf3.png"][/img][/p][h2]A gift from us to you[/h2][p]Because we care, because we understand, and just because we are grateful to have you, in addition to all the incoming FREE content based on the roadmap below, we wanted to reward our early adopters with the exclusive Hot Whiz Suit to thank you for your support. So if you bought the Day 1 Edition - which means the standard edition that was on sale for the first month -, you’ll get the fabulous Hott Whiz suit. It’s pretty, it’s shiny, it’s just like you. Thanks.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/c38b1eddf68b7bb4e249895659dfa4dffd58bdcb.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Roadmap[/h2][p]We wanted to show you that, while still providing support and fixing issues, we have a lot more content in store for you. So in case you missed it, we have a great roadmap ahead that will make Revenge of  the Savage Planet even better, in free upcoming updates for everyone. [/p][p] [/p][p]There’s a little something for everyone: a Photo Mode to unleash your creativity, new challenges, new game modes, new suits, new furniture… So stay tuned, and see what we have in store for you![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/2bcfd46a45acd2d2240fe7f834d197d44e0c1ffe.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]We for sure hope you will like this and wish you a great galactic journey![/p][p] [/p][p]Kane, your Chief Happiness Officer and Community Guru[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: We’re Steam Deck VERIFIED ✅
notes.content:
Great news, explorers! Your interplanetary adventures just got WAY more portable…

Revenge of the Savage Planet is now [b]officially Steam Deck verified[/b], meaning the game is fully functional & fully ridiculous on this mighty little handheld device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/7dca8b65dba47742283b96355f481b03a45fafbf.png[/img]
Now you can fall into lava, squish a critter or ignore Alta’s passive-aggressive emails from literally anywhere. Bed? Nice. Couch? Absolutely. Toilet? Weird flex, but sure.

[h2]What does “verified” actually mean? 🤔[/h2]

Although it might just sound like a cool sticker or something that you could have as a fridge magnet, being verified actually means:

[b]🔶 Full functionality while using default controller configurations
🔶 Steam Deck controller icons are shown
🔶 In-game text is legible
🔶 Our default graphics configuration performs well
🔶 No green goo will leak out of the screen [i](NOT GUARANTEED)
[/i][/b]
All in all, thanks to prior testing our co-op adventure runs smoother than a Babutt’s face… or butt… or whatever.

[h2]Revenge is best served anywhere 🚀[/h2]

Thankfully for a hard-working former employee like yourself, the Savage Planet experience doesn’t have to end when you leave your setup anymore.

Continue “working” wherever you may be in the world because nothing screams productivity more than capturing alien creatures for totally-normal research purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/d0ef7b44e8d8872e1670f1e4daffc4f09874ac89.png[/img]
Forget just one world, you now have [b]FIVE WORLDS[/b] in the palm of your hand. Simply fire up your Steam Deck & get to it!

Have fun out there & remember to follow our socials to stay up to date on everything our team is currently working on 👇

notes.title: Savegame recovery, repeating audio, missing DLCs, optimizations, and more!
notes.content:

Note that the game save backups of your savegames in %localappdata%\RevengeOfTheSavagePlanet\Saved\SaveGames , where you can rename files containing the name 'backup' if you want to manually recover to an older save state. 
- Fixed an issue where the game would not detect DLCs if the user pressed the invite button too many times after confirmation on the welcome screen.

- Fixed a crash when lowering the screen sync interval too much.
- Fixed a crash when using the grapple anywhere tool.
- Fixed different crashes when starting or during online sessions.

This isn’t a drill. This isn’t a teaser. This isn’t an elaborate HR onboarding simulation. [i]We actually finished the game.[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes - 2025-5-6-95793
notes.content:
Dear Space Pioneers, 

The team has been working hard to hunt down, identify, and resolve the issues you've encountered so far. As a reminder, please head to the official Discord if you have any issues or questions. You'll be able to report your bugs in the technical section, at the bottom of the server, 

And please follow the template given: it's not an Alta Sheanigans, it's made to help you even faster!

[b]Version number: 2025-5-6-95793[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed one of the Kindex categories tab that would never unlock. It will now unlock whenever player scans something that goes in that category.

[*] Fixed upgrade "The 'Fancy Nancy' Equipment Tagger" that behaved as if it was acquired from the very start of the game, marking all collectibles on the map as you survey them, while the intended behavior is for players to have to craft that upgrade in order to see those icons on the map.

[*] Added additional display refresh rate options, including those natively supported by the display device, as well as an option to disable vertical sync for potentially better performance at the expense of screen tearing.

[*] Optimized different cutscenes to remove GPU spikes and keep a more stable framerate.

[*] Fixed some input-related issues for keyboard vs controller.
[/list]

Thank you! And keep sending us your feedback!

notes.title: NEW EMPLOYEE FAQ - 1
notes.content:
Greetings, new hire, we’re thrilled to have you here at Alta Interglobal!

Your journey is about to start and we understand that you might have some questions and with that in mind, we tried our bewst to answer them!  eel free to read them - in your sparetime - and get back to us if you have any further concerns.

[h1]🧑‍🚀 When does the mission start?[/h1]

You will be deployed for your century-long space nap on the 8th of May! (Please note that the nap-time will not be compensated for.) The owner of the Deluxe Edition will be able to start their mission on the 5th of May.

[h1]🧑‍🚀🧑‍🚀 Can I bring a friend?[/h1]

This mission is tailored for either solo Space adventurers, or pairs!. We are not responsible if your relationship deteriorates in space. 

[h1]🪐 How many planets will we be able to explore?[/h1]

Fi… Four. Please expect different biomes and fauna that may or may not be hostile.

[h1]🎮 Will it be split-screen or online co-op?[/h1]

Both. Both is nice.

[h1]💻🕹️ Will it cross-platform?[/h1]

Cross-platform indeed!

[h1]❓ What’s new?[/h1]

Brand new gear, collectible  suits,  new flora and fauna to discover, new upgrades to launch you upwards and onwards in style, plus a beautiful new Habitat that you can customize to your heart’s content!. We're bringing a whole new perspective in third person - but we are considering and studying options to bring first person after the release. 

[h1]👀 Is there a way to get a preview of the Space program?[/h1]

No, we want you to be fully ready on May 8th. However, early access is available for some limited bundles. Don’t miss out!

[h1]❤️ Will it be as fun as Journey to the Savage Planet?[/h1]

Alta Interglobal has been working really hard to provide you with a fantastic, unique, and hilarious new adventure. So you can expect goo, explosions, weird creatures, worms, stuff to feed, dog voice, Québécois subbing, COMMERCIALS, Shama Lama, and other shenanigans. It’s bigger, better and definitely crazier. 

If you have any questions, please feel free to reach out to us on Discord or in the comments.

Kane, CHO, Alta Interglobal

notes.title: Martin Tweed Reveals Our LAUNCH DATE 🚀
notes.content:
The time has officially come, explorers! Your next corporate-mandated adventure is exactly 72 DAYS away & Martin Tweed has all the information that might help you survive the first few hours. Not sure about the rest of the time though.

No job? No gear? No plan? NOOOO PROBLEM!

Scour the alien landscapes for resources which you can craft into extremely useful & totally not weird tools that help you overcome any obstacles during your adventure.

Now, if you love Tweed as much as us, you’ll want to feast your eyes on [strike]his[/strike] our latest trailer 👇

[previewyoutube=YLgTkasVIGI;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Mark those calendars 📅[/h2]

We’re letting the cat out of the ba- no! We’re letting the Brainard out of the cryopod!

[b]📣 REVENGE OF THE SAVAGE PLANET LAUNCHES ON MAY 8TH! 📣[/b]

After being made redundant by Alta Interglobal & abandoned on the far edges of space, it’s up to you to find your way home & exact revenge on your former employers.

You’ll be suiting up once more, ready to explore, experiment & maybe explode if you’re not careful.

Whether you were a long-standing employee from Journey to the Savage Planet, or a fresh hire who didn’t make it through their probation, Kindred Aerospace is thrilled to welcome you to our next venture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/47ff51225594edbb0ee9fd4c8cb6d95995c415a8.jpg[/img]

We’ve got new worlds, new dangers & a whole lot more co-op mayhem - INCLUDING splitscreen - so you can share your mishaps with a friend.

We’d normally advise you to take the time off work but, well, you’re redundant anyway! Good luck!

[h2]Introducing the Kindred Catalog 🛒[/h2]

Nothing screams space exploration quite like shopping for explosive pomegranates or a power hose filled with green goo. You know, the normal things you’d buy online

However, you can forget Amazon out here because we’ve got: [b]THE KINDRED CATALOG™️[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/76ff243efaa7554c58bc2819c779547419202d9b.jpg[/img]

Any space explorer worth their weight in Grob carries the right tools for the job & thanks to your former employer you’ll be able to own:

💥 [b]Bombegranates:[/b] Does what it says on the tin. Except there’s no tin. Only a dangerous fruit.
💥 [b]The Goo Canon:[/b] Useful but probably not FDA-approved.
💥 [b]An Alta Interglobal Backpack:[/b] Not just a fashion statement.
💥 [b]Grob Cans:[/b] Yummy. Nutritious. Questionably sourced.
💥 [b]The Lasso & Whip:[/b] Multi-use tool that you’ll need for slapping creatures around, and even safely (most of the time, anyway) transporting them back to your base.

[i]All items are subject to availability.[/i]

[h2]Are you ready? 👀[/h2]

Whether they’re split or not, we’re absolutely STOKED to be bringing Revenge of the Savage Planet to your screens in the near future!

Don’t forget to follow our socials below to stay up to date on all things Martin Tweed, the Kindred Catalog & some super special launch bonuses depending on what platform you’ll be playing on…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/3bc82996ebc3ddc69e3d36f507c36d01e30fb606.jpg[/img]

notes.title: We’re bringing back gaming’s GOLDEN ERA ✨
notes.content:
Steam’s Couch Co-Op Fest is here & you know what that means - it’s time to sit uncomfortably close to your nearest & dearest, grab a controller, & yell at each other over who forgot to scan the weird mushroom thing.

Our Corporate Overlords have told us to say we are thrilled to be part of this because if there’s one thing we love, it’s co-op mayhem! Whether you’re sprinting through alien landscapes or bickering after being booted into a swamp, our game is built for chaotic cooperation.

Oh, the best part? We’ve got MULTIPLE WAYS you can play alongside your best friend, cousin, Pufferbird, or anyone else with cognitive functions.

[h2]Calling all couch owners 🛋️[/h2]

If you own a multiplayer-capable sitting device, i.e. a couch - listen up. If you don’t own a couch, you’re gonna want to buy a couch & then listen up.

Remember the golden age of split-screen gaming? The thrill of playing side-by-side? The emotional scars of a so-called "friend" stealing your loot? We’re bringing it back, baby! But this time, with 100% more corporate satire & approximately 2064%* more goo.

[b]*Goo levels subject to change[/b] 🧪

Whether you’re playing for teamwork or just to see who falls into the most bottomless pits, we’re proud to say Revenge of the Savage Planet is couch co-op at its finest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157720/01c074ea1db4c4249075bf689b0dc732dff8849d.png[/img]

[h2]Co-op chaos goes global 🌍[/h2]

Can’t agree on which side of the couch is the best? No worries, take the chaos online instead.

Nothing bonds coworkers like surviving an alien planet together while plotting vengeance against your former employers & we’re leaving nobody behind as crossplay is available on several platforms from DAY ONE.

Feel free to leave your friends behind if you want, though. We’re not here to judge.

[h2]Launching in style 🚀[/h2]

We know corporate doesn’t usually hand out freebies (unless you count “mandatory overtime”), but this time? You’re in luck!

Spend some of your hard-earned cash on us within the first month of launch on Steam to receive:

🎁 [b]A FREE copy of Journey to the Savage Planet[/b] – That’s right, two titles for the price of one! Remember to bring a friend, a rival, or your weird uncle who won’t stop talking about aliens.
🦝 [b]The Trash Panda Suit[/b] – Because nothing says “space explorer” like dressing as a slightly badass raccoon. Stylish? Absolutely. Sanitary? Debatable.

notes.title: 2025 IS THE YEAR OF THE SAVAGE PLANET 💥
notes.content:
Happy New Year, space explorers! It’s officially THE YEAR OF THE SAVAGE PLANET & we’ve got a fresh batch of juicy updates, hot off the press!
 
If that wasn’t enough to make your space boots tingle, we [i]also[/i] dropped a brand-new trailer featuring something evil, artificial & dangerously interactive… Let’s just say if you unwrapped one of these for the holidays, you’d want to check the return policy. 🤖

[h2]Bloggin’ Hell![/h2]

Sound the corporate klaxon! Some PlayStation overlords from Earth have crash-landed with an update hotter than Nu Florida’s irradiated beaches. It’s basically intergalactic law for you to read it. We won’t spoil all the fun, but here’s a quick rundown of what you probably, potentially, maybe, might find if you do:

✅ [b]Gear & Customization[/b] (New drip for your space suit.)
✅ [b]More Planets[/b] (Not one. Not two. Not three. Keep guessing.)
✅ [b]An Evil AI Robot[/b] (Sentient, sassy, slightly unhinged.)
✅ [b]Retro Pinball Machines[/b] (Wait… what?)
✅ [b]Behind-the-Scenes Developer Thoughts[/b] (Brain juice from the devs.)
✅ [b]FREE STUFF & DISCOUNTS!!![/b] (We had you at free, didn’t we?)

Well, what are you waiting for? Get your eyeballs [url=https://x.com/PlayStation/status/1877400169496371340]HERE[/url] to read all about it 🗞️

[h2]SLAPPI Recall[/h2]

Uhhhh, this might be the worst present ever.

Your [b]Synthetic Learning Android Personalized Programmable Interactivity[/b] (a.k.a SLAPPI) seems to be malfunctioning, which explains the recalls Hott Whiz announced yesterday.

🔴 Hott Whiz just announced a recall.
🔴 There have been multiple reports of “unexpected” & “alarming” behavior.
🔴 Some SLAPPI units may or may not have developed a tendency to eliminate their owners.

We’re still trying to separate fact from fiction, but for your safety (& ours): DO NOT APPROACH.

Oh, & if you haven’t seen the new SLAPPI’s Den of Fun trailer… well… buckle up. 🎥

[previewyoutube=r3h9nyzlFhI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Planets Galore[/h2]

We teased you long enough & thought it was only right to finally reveal the official deets. If you remember Journey to the Savage Planet, you’ll remember one planet. This time? FIVE. Not two, not three, F I V E.

Apparently, revenge is a dish best served on multiple planets. That’s the saying, right?

Each world is packed with new flora, fauna, weird POIs, & definitely things that will try to eat you. Did we mention that SLAPPI’s Den of Fun is a very different kind of adventure? His version of “fun” may not be yours, but we cannot wait to watch your reactions as we reveal more details in the coming weeks 🌍

notes.title: WE ARE SO BACK!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Guess who's back? That's right — we are![/b][/h2]

We heard you when you screamed [i]“I WANT A SEQUEL TO JOURNEY TO THE SAVAGE PLANET!”[/i] every night like a wild Pufferbird. Well the good news is we’re BACK LIKE NEVER BEFORE. 

Welcome to Revenge of the Savage Planet!

New studio (but the same Savage Planet team), new game and a new pair of socks because we’re about to run you through what we’ve been workin’ on. 

[h3][b]Gimme that sweet, sweet lore[/b][/h3]

It’s been a while… Let’s get you caught up.

Kindred Aerospace, proudly the fourth-best space company, is now under new “management” from Alta InterGlobal. After spending nearly a century (wow you’re old!) hurtling through space in cryosleep, making sure you’re well-rested to colonize faraway planets, it turns out that you’re no longer needed and your contract is now toilet paper. 

But hey, let's not dwell on minor setbacks like being stranded billions of miles from Earth. Let's focus on the silver linings: you haven’t become an alien lunch yet.

[h3][b]What’s new?![/b][/h3]

Yeah we’ve been away a while but we’ve put that time to good use. We watered the plants, took origami lessons, but more importantly, built a big ol’ game for you to click buttons in. Here’s the low-down on what’s new in Revenge of the Savage Planet.

[b]Split Screen[/b] - Remember those couch co-op moments? Shouting at each other? Pointing violently towards the screen shouting “GO THERE, DO THAT”? You’ll be able to sit on the same couch and experience new Savage worlds together. Don’t worry, there’s still online co-op AND crossplay too. You’re a spoilt bunch. We love it.

[b]Now in Third Person![/b] - Stare at your character’s derrière or the beautiful landscapes around you in FULL VIEW this time. We’d recommend the first part but there are nice plants too. 

[b]New Outfits[/b] - Research shows people care about what they look like, so we’ve added character customization. That red spacesuit looks great on you in third-person, so flaunt it, baby.

[b]Interplanetary Exploration[/b] - What’s better than one planet? Two? Nope, FOUR. Explore multiple alien habitats each boasting different flora & fauna. There might even be more than four. Maybe. My lips are sealed.

[b]Home Sweet Home[/b] - That janky spaceship you remember is a thing of the past. You’ve been upgraded to a penthouse suite (a.k.a Space Trailer) where you can show off all the weird & wacky things you’ve hoarded with pride. 

[b]New Weapo- I mean… New Tools[/b] - That thing that goes pew pew? It’s back! But we’re also handing you a less-than-lethal lasso you can use to capture little alien fellas and keep them in Pens near your fancy new house. Everyone needs friends & everyone needs a hobby. Two alien birds one massive stone.

[b]Martin Tweed[/b] - [i][REDACTED][/i]

[b]Green Goo[/b] - There’s goo & it’s green. Sounds cool, right? Don’t go near it!

[b]“Don’t go so soon!” you say…[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2787320/Revenge_of_the_Savage_Planet/

Well, you’re caught up. Kind of. We have so much more to tell you and you’d better be following us on your little devices here 👇
